translation: 将这个区域指定为坑的顶部.  公民不会将水填满下面的坑.

translation: 把这个区域指定为池塘的顶部.  如果下面的池塘没有被填满,市民们会带来水桶.

text: Select animals to be dropped into the pit or pond below this zone.  Animals will not feel obligated to stay if they can find a way out.
translation: 选择要放入该区域下方的坑或池塘中的动物.  如果动物能找到出路,它们就不会觉得有义务留下来.

text: Assign a new or existing location to this zone.  Locations are groups of zones and rooms with a larger purpose, like a tavern, a temple, a library, or a craft guildhall.
translation: 将一个新的或现有的地点指派给这个区域.  地点是由区域和房间组成的,具有比较大型的用途,如酒馆, 寺庙, 图书馆或手工业行会.

text: Items designated for dumping will be tossed into open air spaces included in this zone.  If no open air tiles are included, they will dump the items on the floor.
translation: 被指定为倾倒的物品将被扔到包括在这个区域的露天空间.  如果没有包括露天空间的瓷砖,他们将把物品扔在地上.

text: Certain livestock need to graze on grass.  Assign these animals to a pasture zone.  No fencing is needed.
translation: 某些牲畜需要在草地上吃草. 将这些动物分配到牧场区. 不需要围栏.

translation: 被分配到坑/池塘区的动物被扔在坑里,但如果可能的话,之后会离开该区.  如果坑被指定为池塘,你的公民将试图用水桶将其填满.

text: Your citizens will fill sand bags at this zone if a sandy floor or sandy wall is included.  This task is initiated manually at the glass furnace.
translation: 如果包括沙地或沙墙,你的公民将在这个区域填充沙袋.  这个任务是在玻璃熔炉处手动启动的.

text: Your citizens will collect clay at this zone if a clay floor or clay wall is included.  This task is initiated manually at the kiln.
translation: 如果包括粘土地面或粘土墙,你的公民将在这个区域收集粘土.  这个任务是在窑洞里手动启动的.

text: This important zone is where your citizens will gather to socialize.  Crucially, the meeting area is where locations such as taverns, temples, hospitals, and the like are established.
translation: 这个重要区域是您的公民聚集社交的地方.  至关重要的是,会议区是建立酒馆, 寺庙, 医院等场所的地方.

text: Animals that are capable of being trained receive their training at this zone once they have been assigned a trainer from the Pets/Livestock menu.  Generally, a piece of meat is required.
translation: 能够接受训练的动物一旦从宠物/家畜菜单中被分配了训练师,就会在该区域接受训练. 一般来说,一块肉是必须的.

text: Your citizens will sleep in bedrooms.  It should include a bed!  Try to enclose it with walls and/or doors.  Do not overlap with other rooms.
translation: 你的公民将睡在卧室里.  它应该包括一张床! 尝试用墙壁和/或门将其封闭.  (不能与其他房间重叠)

text: Your citizens will eat at this zone.  When not assigned to a particular citizen, citizens without their own dining hall will eat here.  Tables and adjacent chairs should be included.
translation: 你的市民将在此处就餐.  若没有分配给特定市民,则未分配食堂的市民也会在这里用餐(需要包括桌子和相邻的椅子)

text: An office or study is required for certain official tasks, such as approving work orders and bookkeeping.  A chair or throne is required for these functions.
translation: 某些办公任务需要办公室或书房,例如批准工作订单和簿记. 这些功能需要椅子或宝座.

text: Your archers can train in this zone if there is an archery target included.
translation: 如果此处有靶子,则您的弓箭手可在此训练

text: Squads should be assigned to a barracks.  The squad can be set to train, sleep, and store equipment there.
translation: 小队需要被分配到一个军营.  小队可以设置为在那里训练, 睡觉和存放装备.

text: Dormitories should include multiple beds and will not belong to a particular citizen.
translation: 宿舍应包括多张床,不属于特定居民.

text: Prisoners convicted in the Justice menu can be incarcerated at a chain or metal cage in the dungeon zone.
translation: 在司法菜单中被定罪的囚犯可以被监禁在地牢区的铁链或金属笼子里.

text: Deceased citizens and pets can be laid to rest in a tomb.  It should include a coffin, casket, or sarcophagus.
translation: 死去的公民和宠物可以被安放在坟墓里.  它应该包括一个棺材,匣子,或石棺.

text: Establish burrows to organize work and living spaces in larger fortresses.
translation: 在较大的堡垒中建立洞穴来组织工作和生活空间.

text: Remove the burrow being painted permanently.  Also removes existing burrows!
translation: 永久性地清除被涂抹的洞穴.  同时也能清除现有的洞穴!

text: Erase a portion of this burrow.
translation: 抹去这个洞穴的一部分.
永久性地清除这个洞穴.

text: Toggle whether workshops can source materials from outside the burrow.
translation: 切换工场是否能从洞穴外获取材料.

text: Suspend this burrow.  Assigned citizens will not respect burrow restrictions while a burrow is suspended, but all tasks within the burrow will still function.
translation: 暂停这个洞穴.  当一个洞穴被暂停时,分配的公民将不尊重洞穴的限制,但洞穴内的所有任务仍将运作.

text: Add a stop to this route.  Minecarts will move between stops when conditions are satisfied.
translation: 为这条路线添加一个停靠点. 当条件满足时,矿车将在站点之间移动.

text: Assign a minecart to this route.  Only one vehicle can operate on each route.
translation: 为这条路线分配一个矿车. 每条路线只能运行一辆车.

text: Set the items desired by the minecart at this stop.  Items must be in a linked stockpile.
translation: 在这一站设置矿车所需的物品.  物品必须是在一个链接的库存中.

text: Link a stockpile to this stop.  Citizens will haul items to and from the minecart as you specify.  Items for the minecart must be specified using the desired items button to the left.
translation: 将库存链接到此站点. 市民将按照您指定的方式将物品运进和运出矿车. 必须使用左侧的所需物品按钮指定矿车的物品.

text: Set conditions for the minecart to move on to the next stop.
translation: 为矿车移动到下一站设置条件.

text: The assigned vehicle is at this stop.
translation: 指定车辆正在此站点停靠.

text: The assigned vehicle is moving toward this stop.
translation: 指定的车辆正在驶向该停靠点.

text: The assigned vehicle wants to be at this stop but is not currently there.  A worker may be bringing it, or it may be stranded.
translation: 被分配的车辆想在这一站,但目前不在那里.  可能有工作人员带着它,也可能是它被搁置了.

text: Open the nobles and administrators menu.
translation: 打开贵族和管理员菜单.

text: Toggle whether the stockpile allows plant and animal-based objects, regardless of other settings.
translation: 切换库存是否允许基于植物和动物的物体,而不考虑其他设置.

text: Toggle whether the stockpile allows non-plant-and-animal-based objects, regardless of other settings.
translation: 切换库存是否允许非植物和动物的物体,不考虑其他设置.

text: Toggle whether goods banned by export mandates are listed.
translation: 切换是否列出出口授权禁止的货物.

text: Sort by distance from the depot.
Leave menu and recenter the view on the time.
translation: 离开菜单,将视图重新集中在时间上.

text: Leave menu and open the item's sheet.
translation: 离开菜单,打开项目的工作表.

text: Toggle the forbidden status of the item.  Citizens will not use forbidden items or buildings.
translation: 切换项目的禁止状态.  公民不会使用违禁物品或建筑物.

text: Toggle the dump status of the item.  Items are dumped in dumping zones.
translation: 切换物品的倾倒状态.  物品被倾倒在倾倒区.

text: Toggle the melt status of the item.  Items are melted at any smelter.
translation: 切换物品的融化状态. 物品可在任何冶炼厂熔化.

text: Toggle the visibility of the item.  Hidden items cannot be seen but citizens will still use them.
translation: 切换物品的可见性.  隐藏的物品不能被看到,但市民仍会使用它们.

text: Create a new work order.  Work orders are like workshop jobs but they are assigned to shops automatically and can be activated with various conditions.
translation: 创建一个新的指令.  指令就像车间的工作,但它们被自动分配到车间,并可以用各种条件激活.

text: This work order is waiting for its next scheduled check.
translation: 该工作订单正等待下一轮时间表检查.

text: This work order is checking its conditions for activation.
translation: 该工作订单正检查其激活条件.

text: This work order is ready to activate.
translation: 该工作订单已准备好被激活.

text: Set the maximum number of workshops that can be used by the work order.
translation: 设置工作订单可被最多用于多少个工坊.

text: This work order has been validated by the manager.
translation: 该工作订单已被经理人设置为生效.

text: This work order has not been validated by the manager.  A manager can be employed in the nobles and administrators menu, and they must have an assigned office where they will work to validate orders.
translation: 此工单尚未由经理验证. 可以在贵族和管理员菜单中启用经理,他们必须有一个指定的办公室,他们将在那里工作以验证订单.

text: Change the number of times the task will be performed.
translation: 更改任务将被执行的次数.

text: Change the work order priority.  Work orders at the top of the list will use workshops first.
translation: 更改工作订单的优先级. 工坊将首先完成位于列表顶端的工作订单.

text: Set the conditions for work order activation.  This can involve needed materials, the current stock of products, or the completion of other work orders.
translation: 设置工单激活的条件. 这可能涉及所需材料, 当前产品库存或其他工单的完成情况.

text: Set the material used or other details of the task.
translation: 设置任务使用的材料或其他详细信息.

text: Change the frequency that the conditions are checked.
Add a condition to the work order that checks the amount of some item.
translation: 为工作订单添加检查物品数量时设定的条件.

text: Make the activation of the work order depend on the status of another work order.
translation: 使工单的激活取决于另一个工单的状态.

text: Change the amount of the item being checked.
translation: 更改要检查的物品的数量.

text: Change the inequality of the condition.
Change the type of the item being checked.
translation: 改变被检查项目的类型.

text: Change the material of the item being checked.
translation: 改变被检查物品的材料.

text: Change the properties of the item being checked.  Many of these are obscure and rely on specific tasks, but certain properties like 'empty' can be used in many conditions.
translation: 改变被检查项目的属性.  其中许多是晦涩难懂的,依赖于特定的任务,但某些属性如'空'可以在许多条件下使用.

text: Change whether the work order must be activated or completed to satisfy this condition.
translation: 改变指令是否必须被激活或完成以满足这个条件.

text: Leave this menu and recenter on this creature.
translation: 离开该菜单并重定位至该生物.

text: Leave this menu and view this creature's sheet.
translation: 离开该菜单并查看这个生物的列表.

text: Leave this menu and recenter on this object.
translation: 离开该菜单并重定位至该物体.

text: Leave this menu and view this object's sheet.
translation: 离开该菜单并查看这个物品的列表.

text: Leave this menu and recenter on this place.
translation: 离开该菜单并重定位至该地区.

text: Leave this menu and view this place's sheet or menu.
translation: 离开该菜单并查看该地区的列表或菜单.

text: Leave this menu and recenter on the task's building.
translation: 离开这个菜单,重新定位到任务的建筑上.

text: Set the details of this task, such as the material used.
translation: 设置该任务的细节,例如使用什么材料.

text: View a detailed description of this activity.
translation: 检查该活动的描述详情.

text: Toggle whether the task will be repeated indefinitely.
translation: 切换是否无限重复任务.

text: Remove the current worker from the task.
translation: 将工人从当前任务中移除.

text: Suspend this task.  This removes the worker.  The task can be unsuspended.
translation: 暂停此任务. 这将移除工人. 可以取消暂停任务.

text: Assign a trainer to this creature.
translation: 为该生物指派一个驯兽师.

text: Assign this creature as a work animal for a specific citizen or resident.
translation: 将该生物指派给一个特定的居民或长期居住者作为工作动物.

text: Toggle whether this creature will receive war training.  War animals have more lethal attacks.
translation: 切换该生物是否会接受战斗训练.  战斗动物有更多机会发起致命攻击.

text: Toggle whether this creature will receive hunting training.  Hunting animals can move stealthfully during hunts.
translation: 切换该生物是否会接受狩猎训练.  狩猎动物在狩猎过程中可以隐蔽地移动.

text: Toggle whether this creature is available as a pet for any interested citizen or resident.
translation: 切换这种生物是否可以作为宠物供任何感兴趣的公民或居民使用.

text: This creature is ecstatic right now.
This creature is happy right now.
This creature is pleased right now.
This creature is content right now.
This creature is displeased right now.
This creature is unhappy right now.
This creature is miserable right now.
This worker is specialized and will only do tasks that match their workshop assignments, work details, and occupations.  Click to toggle.
translation: 这是个专职工人,只会做与车间分配, 工作细节和职业相匹配的任务. 单击可切换.

text: This worker is not specialized and will do any free tasks that become available.  Click to toggle.
translation: 这个工人无专职工作,可以做任何自由任务. 单击切换.

text: This creature is a tavern keeper.
This creature is a monster slayer.
translation: 该生物是一名怪物猎手.

text: This creature is assigned to a specific workshop.
translation: 该生物被指派到一个特定的工坊.

text: This creature is assigned to a work detail.
translation: 该生物被指派给一项工作细节.

text: Toggle whether this creature will be slaughtered at a butcher's shop when the opportunity arises.
translation: 切换这种生物是否会在有机会的时候在肉店被宰杀.

text: Toggle whether this creature will be gelded at a farmer's workshop when the opportunity arises.
translation: 切换这个生物在合适时是否会在农用工场被阉割.

text: This type is not relevant to brewing.
This type is restricted from brewing.
This type is allowed to be brewed.
This type is not relevant to cooking.
This type is restricted from cooking.
This type is allowed to be cooked.
This option allows visitors from outside the fortress to enter this location.
translation: 此选项允许要塞外的游客进入该地点.

text: This option allows long-term residents of the fortress to enter this location.
translation: 这个选项允许堡垒的长期居民进入这个地方.

text: This option indicates that the location is only open to fortress citizens.
translation: 这个选项表示该地点只对要塞公民开放.

text: This option indicates that the location is only open to members.
translation: 该选项表示该地点只对成员开放.

text: Remove this worker from this occupation.
translation: 将该工人从该职业中移除.

text: Set the camera to follow this item.
This item is tagged by a task and will not be used by other tasks.
translation: 这个物品已被某个任务选用,无法再用于其他任务.

text: Customize this creature's nickname and profession nickname.
translation: 自定义这个生物的昵称和职业昵称.

text: Set the camera to follow this creature.
Send this creature to a linked site, or expel this creature entirely.
translation: 把这个生物送到一个链接的站点,或者完全驱逐这个生物.

text: This item is part of the assigned squad equipment.
translation: 这件物品是已分配小队装备的一部分

text: This item is a tool assigned by a work detail.
translation: 这个项目是由一个工作细节分配的工具.

text: This item is a symbol of a noble or administrator.
translation: 这件物品是贵族或管理员的象征.

text: This item is part of the creature's regular clothing.
translation: 这个项目是该生物常规服装的一部分.
查看有关该知识的细节.

text: This task has been assigned and is active.
translation: 该任务已被指派且已激活.

text: This task came from a work order.
translation: 该任务来自一项工作订单.

text: This task is set to repeat indefinitely.
translation: 该任务已被设置为无限重复.

text: Click to set this task to repeat indefinitely.
translation: 单击可将此任务设置为无限重复.

text: This task is highest priority among all tasks everywhere.
translation: 这个任务是所有任务中优先级最高的.

text: Click to set this task as highest priority among all tasks everywhere.
translation: 点击将此任务设置为各地所有任务中的最高优先级.

text: Increase the priority of the task in this workshop.
translation: 提高该任务在这个工坊里的优先级.

text: Set details for this task, such as the material to be used.
translation: 为这项任务设置细节,如要使用的材料.

text: Click to suspend the task.  Assigned workers are removed from suspended tasks.
translation: 点击暂停任务.  已分配的工人将从暂停的任务中移除.

text: Create a new work order for this workshop.  Work orders are tasks that can repeat specified numbers of times and which can be given start conditions.  This is useful for automation.
translation: 为这个工坊创建一个新工单,工单是可以重复指定次数的任务,并且可以给定启动条件. 这对自动化很有用.
重新定位在链接的建筑物上.

text: Add stockpile links for this workshop.
translation: 为这个车间添加库存区链接.

text: This item is a permanent part of the building.  Forbid and visibility tags set here affect the whole building.
translation: 这个项目是建筑物的一个永久的部分.  在这里设置的禁止和可见性标签会影响整个建筑.

text: This is a small creature within the trap.
translation: 这是一个陷阱中的小生物.

text: This item is resting within the building.
This item is a semi-permanent part of the building, like an item on display.
translation: 这个项目是建筑的一个半永久性的部分,就像所示项目.

text: Toggle the forbidden status of the item.  Citizens will not use forbidden items or buildings.  If a permanent building item is forbidden, citizens will not perform tasks there!
translation: 切换项目的禁止状态.  公民不会使用禁止物品或建筑物.  如果永久建筑项目被禁止,公民将不会在那里执行任务!

text: Toggle the visibility of the item.  Hidden items cannot be seen but citizens will still use them.  If a permanent building item is invisible, the building will be too!
translation: 切换项目的可见性.  隐藏的物品是看不见的,但市民仍会使用它们.  如果永久性建筑项目是不可见的,那么建筑也会是!

text: The soldiers can either keep their equipment on at all times, or only when an order is active.
translation: 将士们可以一直随身携带着他们的装备,或者只在被征召时才带上他们的装备

text: The soldiers can be allowed to sleep in their rooms whenever they way, or in the barracks either when they want or only when they must.
translation: 士兵们可以随时睡在自己的房间里,也可以在他们想要或必须的时候睡在军营里.
取消这个职位的预定命令.

text: The squad leader is traveling or otherwise occupied off-site.
translation: 班长在旅行或以其他方式在场外活动.

text: View the positions in this squad.
Assign a station order.  The soldiers will stand near the point selected and engage any hostile creatures that come near.
translation: 指派一个站位命令.  士兵们将站在选定的点附近,与任何靠近的敌对生物交战.

text: Assign a kill order.  The soldiers will attempt to kill a targeted creature.
translation: 为小队分配杀戮命令. 士兵将尝试杀死目标生物.

text: Assign a patrol order.  The soldiers will walk a specified route repeatedly.
translation: 为小队分配巡逻命令. 士兵会在指定路线上反复巡逻.

text: Assign a burrow defense order.  The soldiers will patrol the burrow and attack any hostile creatures.
translation: 为小队分配保卫洞穴指令. 士兵将巡逻指定的洞穴并攻击任何敌对生物.

text: Assign a training order.  The squad must be assigned to a barracks zone with the training option set.
translation: 为小队分配训练指令. 该小队必须被分配至一个训练功能开启的营房.

text: Cancel an order.  Does not affect scheduled orders.
translation: 取消一个指令.  不影响预定的指令.
重新定位在公告的位置.

text: Recenter on the creature (at the time of the announcement.)
translation: 重新定位在生物上(在通知的时候. )

text: Recenter on the item (at the time of the announcement.)
translation: 重新关注这个项目(在通知的时候. )

text: Toggle whether the squad will sleep here.
translation: 切换小队是否会在这里睡觉.

text: Toggle whether the squad will train here.
translation: 切换小队是否会在这里训练.

text: Toggle whether the soldiers will store their individually assigned weapons and armor here.
translation: 切换士兵是否会在这里存放他们单独分配的武器和盔甲.

text: Toggle whether the squad will store squad-level equipment here, such as ammunition.
translation: 切换小队是否会在这里存放小队级别的装备,例如弹药.

text: Choose a stockpile to which the track stop's vehicle will give items.
translation: 选择一个储物堆,轨道站的车辆将会提供物品.

text: Choose a stockpile from which the track stop's vehicle will take items.
translation: 选择一个储物堆,轨道站的车辆从那里获取物品.

text: Choose a stockpile with which the track stop's vehicle will exchange items.  The vehicle will take desired items and offload any others.
translation: 选择一个储物堆,轨道站的车辆将与该仓库交换物品.  车辆将取走所需物品,并卸下任何其他物品.

text: Choose a stockpile to which the workshop will give items.
translation: 选择一个库存,车间将向其提供物品.

text: Choose a stockpile from which the workshop will take items.
translation: 选择一个库存,车间将从中提取物品.

text: Choose a stockpile to which the selected stockpile will give items.
translation: 选择一个储存库,所选储存库将向其提供物品.

text: Choose a stockpile from which the selected stockpile will take items.
translation: 选择一个储物堆,所选的储物堆将从中获取物品.

text: The track stop's vehicle will exchange items with this stockpile.  The vehicle will take desired items and offload any others.
translation: 轨道站的车辆将与这个库存交换物品.  车辆将取走所需物品,并卸下任何其他物品.

text: The track stop's vehicle will take items from this stockpile.
translation: 轨道站的车辆将从这个储存库中提取物品.

text: The track stop's vehicle will give items to this stockpile.
translation: 轨道站的车辆会将物品交给这个储存库.

text: The selected workshop will take items from here.
translation: 选定的研讨会将从这里开始进行项目.

text: The selected workshop will give items to here.
translation: 被选中的车间将向这里提供物品.

text: The selected stockpile will take items from here.
translation: 选定的库存将从这里提取物品.

text: The selected stockpile will give items to here.
translation: 选定的库存将向此处提供物品.

text: The creature is set to be chained.
The creature is set to be caged.
translation: 该生物被设置为关在笼子里.

text: The creature is assigned to a pasture.
translation: 该生物被分配到一个牧场.

text: The creature is assigned to a pond.
translation: 该生物被分配到一个池塘.

text: The creature is assigned to a pit.
translation: 该生物被分配到一个坑.
编辑重新定位的热键位置.

text: Recenter on the surface at this location.
translation: 在这个位置的表面上重新定位.

text: Recenter on the deepest discovered area at this location.
translation: 在这个位置上,将中心放在最深的被发现区域.
在这个位置上重新定位.

text: Set this entry to recenter on the current view.
translation: 设置此条目以在当前视图上重新定位.
清除这个重新定位的热键位置.
清除这个重新定位的位置.

text: Display water and magma depth numerically (1 to 7.)
translation: 使用数字(1-7)显示水和岩浆的深度.

text: Show up and down arrows over ramps at the current elevation.
translation: 在当前高度处的斜坡上显示向上和向下箭头.

text: Zoom in on the play area.
Zoom out from the play area.
Open the stocks window, where you can see all of your fortress's items.
translation: 打开库存窗口,在这里你可以看到你的堡垒的所有物品.

text: Most tasks in the fortress are started and completed at workshops.  Tasks generally require raw materials and most workshops are constructed from boulders, blocks, or wood.
translation: 要塞中的大多数任务都是在工场开始和完成的.  任务一般需要原材料,大多数工场都是由巨石, 木块或木材建造的.

text: Furnaces are used for smelting, glassmaking, pottery, ashmaking, or to make fuel from wood or raw coal.  Furnaces require fuel to function, or they can be set above magma.
translation: 炉子用于冶炼, 玻璃制造, 制陶, 制灰,或用木材或原煤制造燃料.  炉子需要燃料才能运作,或者可以设置在岩浆之上.

text: These workshops are used in the clothesmaking process, whether dyeing and weaving or using tanned hides.
translation: 这些工场在制衣过程中,无论是染色和编织,还是使用鞣制的皮革,都会用到.

text: A wide variety of food-and-drink-related workshops can be found in this category.
translation: 在这一类别中可以找到各种与食品和饮食有关的车间.

text: Use options in this category to place furniture that has already been constructed in a workshop.
translation: 使用这个类别的选项来放置已经在车间里建造好的家具.

text: Place doors and hatches here after you have constructed them in an appropriate workshop.
translation: 在适当的车间里建造好门和舱门后,将其放在这里.

text: Most terrain-altering constructions can be found here, from walls and floors to bridges, ramps, stairs, and more.
translation: 大多数改变地形的建筑都可以在这里找到,从墙壁和地板到桥梁, 坡道, 楼梯等等.

text: More complicated buildings from wells to powered machine components to levers and floodgates are found here.
translation: 从水井到动力机械部件再到杠杆和水闸等更复杂的建筑在这里都能找到.

text: Cages, ropes, and animal traps are found here.  Cages can be used in cage traps or to transport large animals.  Metal cages and chains are also used by the justice system.
translation: 这里有笼子, 绳索和动物诱捕器.  笼子可用于笼中陷阱或运输大型动物.  金属笼子和铁链也被司法系统使用.

text: Various mechanical traps can be found here.  The pressure plate is also found here, which has applications beyond traps.
translation: 在这里可以找到各种机械陷阱.  这里还可以找到压力板,它的应用超出了陷阱.

text: Archery targets, siege weapons, and some ornamental display items can be found in this category.
translation: 箭靶, 攻城武器和一些装饰性展示品都可以在这个类别中找到.

text: This crucial building is where all trading will be done.  Pack animals from distant civilizations will need to access this building from the edge of the map.  Later, wagons will need a clear 3-wide path to the depot.
translation: 这座关键的建筑是所有贸易的地方.  来自遥远文明的驮运动物将需要从地图的边缘进入这个建筑.  后来,马车将需要一条清晰的3米宽的小路通往车厂.

text: Used to make lye, potash, and milk of lime.  Construction requires blocks, barrel, and a bucket.
translation: 用于制造碱液, 钾盐和石灰乳.  建造时需要木块, 木桶和一个水桶.

text: Make crossbows here from wood or bone.  The metalsmith's forge can be used for metal crossbows and metal bolts, and the crafts workshop is used to make other bolts.
translation: 在这里用木头或骨头制作弩箭.  金匠的锻造厂可以用来制作金属弩和金属螺栓,而手工艺作坊则用来制作其他的螺栓.

text: Make beds and various furniture here, as well as bins, barrels, and more.
translation: 在这里制作床铺和各种家具,以及垃圾桶,圆桶等.

text: Make crafts for trade and your own citizens here, as well as a variety of tools, armor, and bolts.
translation: 在这里为贸易和你自己的公民制作工艺品,以及各种工具, 盔甲和螺栓.

text: Cut rough gems here to increase their value, and improve the value of other objects by encrusting them with cut gems.
translation: 在这里切割粗糙的宝石以提高其价值,并可以通过镶嵌切割宝石以提高其他物品的价值.

text: Forge weapons and armor here, as well as most other metal objects from furniture to trap components.  Magma below the forge will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the forge above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 在这里锻造武器和盔甲,以及家具和陷阱组件的大多数其他金属物品. 熔炉下方的岩浆将给工作提供动力. 你负责将熔炉放置在岩浆上方,但不需要任何燃料.

text: Make mechanisms here which are used to make levers, pressure plates, and gears.  You can also use mechanisms to link levers and pressure plates to other machinery.
translation: 在这里用来制作杠杆, 压力板和齿轮.  你还可以用机械装置将杠杆和压力板与其他机械连接起来.

text: Forge weapons and armor here, as well as most other metal objects from furniture to trap components.  These tasks require fuel.
translation: 在这里锻造武器和盔甲,以及家具和陷阱组件的大多数其他金属物品. 这些任务需要燃料.

text: Here you can make parts for ballistae and catapults.  This workshop is also the place where ballista ammo is assembled.
translation: 在这里你可以制造弩炮和弹射器的零件,这个工坊也是组装弩炮弹药的车间.

text: Make stone furniture here, as well as blocks which are used in constructions.
translation: 在这里制作石质家具,以及用于建筑的砖块.

text: Use leather tanned at the tanner's shop here to make clothing and tools, such as bags and waterskins.
translation: 使用在这里的制革店来鞣制皮革以制作衣服和工具,如袋子和革制水袋.

text: Here you can turn thread into cloth, whether it is thread from the farmer's workshop or spider silk gathered underground.
translation: 在这里,你可以把线变成布,无论是来自农民工坊的线还是地底收集的蜘蛛丝.

text: Use dyes here to color thread and cloth.  Requires a barrel and bucket for construction.
translation: 在这里使用染料为线和布上色.  需要一个圆桶和水桶来建造.

text: Brew alcohol from plants, fruit, or honey.
translation: 用植物, 水果或蜂蜜酿造酒精.

text: Slaughter livestock here in order to obtain meat, hides, bones, and other animal products.
translation: 在这里屠宰牲畜以获得肉, 皮, 骨头和其他畜产品.

text: Make leather from animal hides here.  You can also make parchment using milk of lime and a hide.
translation: 在这里用动物的皮毛制作皮革.  你也可以用石灰乳和一张皮制作羊皮纸.

text: Process raw fish into edible food here.  Raw fish will not be eaten.
translation: 在这里将生鱼加工成可食用的食物.  生鱼不会被吃掉.

text: Cook meals here.  You can also render fat into tallow.
translation: 在这里做饭.  你也可以将脂肪转化为牛油.

text: Process plants and work with livestock here.  Milk and shear animals, make cheese, and spin thread.
translation: 在这里加工植物并与牲畜一起工作.  挤奶和剪羊毛,制作奶酪,以及纺线.

text: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here.  Tasks are completed very slowly compared to the powered millstone.
translation: 在这里制作糖, 面粉和各种有用的泥浆.  与动力磨石相比,任务完成得非常慢.

text: Capture and train small animals here.  Requires animal traps.
translation: 在这里捕捉和训练小动物.  需要动物陷阱.

text: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here.  Powered version of the quern.  Must be hooked to a windmill or water wheel to function.
translation: 在这里制作糖, 面粉和各种有用的浆料.  石磨的高级版本.  必须与风车或水轮挂钩才能发挥作用.

text: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass.  You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone.  Glassmaking requires fuel.
translation: 你可以用三种不同类型的玻璃制作各种物品.  如果你有一个沙子收集区,你还可以从源自这里的任务中收集袋装沙子.  制作玻璃需要燃料.

text: Bake clay objects here, as well as a few other useful materials.  Clay can also be collected here if you have a clay collection zone.  All tasks require fuel aside from clay collection.
translation: 在这里烘烤粘土物品,以及其他一些有用的材料.  如果你有一个粘土收集区,也可以在这里收集粘土.  除了收集粘土之外,所有的任务都需要燃料.

text: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass.  You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone.  Magma below the furnace will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the furnace above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 你可以用三种不同类型的玻璃制作各种物体.  如果你有一个沙子收集区,你还可以从源自这里的任务中收集袋装沙子.  熔炉下面的岩浆会给任务提供动力.  你要负责将熔炉放在岩浆上方,但不需要其他燃料.

text: Bake clay objects here, as well as a few other useful materials.  Clay can also be collected here if you have a clay collection zone.  Magma below the kiln will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the kiln above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 在这里烘焙粘土制品,以及其他一些有用的材料. 如果你有一个粘土收集区,也可以在这里收集粘土. 窑下的岩浆将为任务提供动力. 你负责将窑置于岩浆之上,但不需要其他燃料.

text: Make metal bars from ore here.  Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys.  Magma below the smelter will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the smelter above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 在这里用矿石制作金属条.  也可以将煤提炼成可用的燃料或制造合金.  冶炼厂下面的岩浆将为任务提供动力.  你要负责将冶炼厂放在岩浆之上,但不需要其他燃料.

text: Make metal bars from ore here.  Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys.  All tasks require fuel.
translation: 在这里用矿石制作金属条.  也可以将煤提炼成可用的燃料或制造合金.  所有任务都需要燃料.

text: Make charcoal and ash from wood here.  Does not require fuel.
translation: 在这里用木材制作木炭和灰烬.  不需要燃料.

text: Plant crops at the farmplot.  You will need seeds or spawn and must select crops by season.  Crops can be fertilized with potash.  Soil is richer deeper underground.
translation: 在农田里种植农作物.  你需要种子或卵子,必须按季节选择农作物.  农作物可以用钾肥施肥.  土壤在地下深处更丰富.

text: When placed, a female bird will claim the box and start laying eggs, if one is available.
translation: 当被放置时,如果有一个盒子的话,一只雌鸟会认领这个盒子并开始下蛋.

text: Keep a colony of insects at your hives.  A wild colony must be collected after the hive is placed, or a colony can be split from an existing hive colony.
translation: 在你的蜂巢中保持一个虫群.  必须在放置蜂巢后收集一个野生蜂群,或者从现有的蜂巢群中分出一个蜂群.

text: Your citizens need a comfortable place to sleep.  A bed object must be made at the carpenter's shop before it can be placed.
translation: 你的公民需要一个舒适的地方来睡觉.  床的物件必须在木匠的商店里制作,然后才能放置.

text: Chairs are required for offices to function, and a chair next to a table is the preferred dining arrangement.  A chair/throne object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 椅子是办公室运作的必要条件,而桌子旁边的椅子是首选的用餐安排.  椅子/骨架物品必须在放置前制作好.

text: Tables are required for dining.  A chair should be placed adjacent to the table.  A table object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 用餐时需要有桌子.  应在桌子旁边放置一把椅子.  桌子上的物品必须在放置前制作好.

text: Chests and coffers are used in personal bedrooms for storing non-clothing objects.  They are also used in some zone-based locations like taverns, hospitals, and libraries for storing useful materials.  A box object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 箱子和保险箱用于个人卧室,用于储存非衣物物品.  它们也被用于一些区域性的场所,如酒馆, 医院和图书馆,用于储存有用的材料.  在放置箱子之前,必须先制作一个箱子对象.

text: Cabinets are used in personal bedrooms for storing clothing objects.  A cabinet object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 柜子用于个人卧室,用于存放衣物物件.  柜子里的物件必须先做出来,然后才能放置.

text: The dead are buried in coffins.  Coffins must be placed in their own tomb zone in order to work.  A coffin object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 死者被埋在棺材里.  棺材必须放置在自己的墓区才能发挥作用.  在放置棺材之前,必须先制作一个棺材对象.

text: Citizens that cannot be buried properly can still be memorialized on slabs.  Slabs are created and engraved at the stoneworker's shop.
translation: 不能正确埋葬的公民仍然可以在石板上留念.  石板是在石匠的店里制作和雕刻的.

text: Statues can be used to decorate your fortress and add value to your rooms.  A statue object must be made at an appropriate workshop first.
translation: 雕像可以用来装饰你的堡垒,为你的房间增加价值.  雕像对象必须先在适当的工场制作.

text: Certain injuries such as overlapping fractures require advanced medical contraptions like the traction bench for treatment.  A traction bench object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 某些伤害,如重叠骨折,需要像牵引凳这样的先进医疗装置进行治疗.  牵引凳的物件必须在放置前制作好.

text: Codices and scrolls in your library can be stored in bookcases.  A bookcase object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 你图书馆中的法典和卷轴可以存放在书柜中.  在放置书柜之前,必须先制作一个书柜对象.

text: These ornamental objects increase the value of rooms in which they are placed.  An offering place object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 这些装饰品能提高它们所处房间的价值.  在摆放之前,必须先制作一个供奉的物品.

text: Large instruments must be placed in taverns or temples before they will be used.  These instruments must be assembled at a workshop first.
translation: 大型仪器在使用前必须放在酒馆或寺庙中.  这些乐器必须先在工场进行组装.

text: Doors can be used along with walls to enclose rooms, which is especially important when placing multiple zones at once.  Doors can also be forbidden or attached to levers to control movement in the fort.
translation: 门可以和墙一起用来封闭房间,这在同时放置多个区域时尤其重要.  门也可以被禁止或连接到杠杆上,以控制堡垒中的运动.

text: Hatches can be placed at the tops of stairwells or above ramps to control movement in the fort when they are forbidden or attached to levers.
translation: 舱口可以放置在楼梯间的顶部或坡道上方,以控制堡垒中的运动,当它们被禁止或连接到杠杆时.

text: Bridges can be used to span open spaces or placed above water or magma.  Bridges can be connected to levers and raised to block access.
translation: 桥梁可以用来跨越空旷的空间,或者放置在水或岩浆之上.  桥梁可以与杠杆相连,并升起以阻断通道.

text: Paved roads use less materials than constructed floors and can be used to stop plants from growing over wagon trails.
translation: 铺设的道路比建造的地板使用更少的材料,可以用来阻止植物在马车道上生长.

text: Dirt roads do not require materials, but the dirt road may quickly be overgrown by plants.
translation: 土路不需要材料,但土路可能很快就会被植物所覆盖.

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built on any floor.  Grates unlike bars have a quality and enhance the value of rooms.  Grates can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物,但允许液体和物品通过.  可以建在任何楼层.  栅栏与酒吧不同,它具有质量,可以提高房间的价值.  栅栏可以与杠杆连接.

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built over empty spaces, stairs, ramps, or above liquids.  Grates unlike bars have a quality and enhance the value of rooms.  Grates can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物,但允许液体和物品通过.  可以建在空地, 楼梯, 坡道或液体上方.  栅栏与酒吧不同,它具有质量,可以提高房间的价值.  栅栏可以与杠杆连接.

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built on any floor.  Bars unlike grates do not have a quality and so do not enhance the value of rooms significantly.  Bars can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物,但允许液体和物品通过.  可以建在任何楼层.  栏杆与栅栏不同,没有质量,因此不能显著提高房间的价值.  栏杆可以与杠杆连接.

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built over empty spaces, stairs, ramps, or above liquids.  Bars unlike grates do not have a quality and so do not enhance the value of rooms significantly.  Bars can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物,但允许液体和物品通过.  可以建在空地, 楼梯, 坡道或液体上方.  栏杆与栅栏不同,没有质量,因此不能显著提高房间的价值.  栏杆可以与杠杆相连.

text: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms.  A window object must be made at a glass furnace before it can be placed.
translation: 这种装饰性建筑可以提高房间的价值.  窗户的物件必须在玻璃熔炉中制作,然后才能放置.

text: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms.  Three cut gem objects must be made at a jeweler's shop before it can be placed.
translation: 这种装饰性建筑可以提高房间的价值.  三种切割的宝石物体必须在珠宝店制作,然后才能放置.

text: Supports will stop cave-ins in the rare event you completely detach a piece of your fortress.  Otherwise, they are ornamental.
translation: 在你完全脱离你的堡垒的极少数情况下,支撑物可以阻止塌陷的发生.  否则,它们是装饰性的.

text: You can build walls aboveground, in caverns, or in spaces you have mined out in order to block the passage of creatures, objects, and fluids.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 你可以在地上, 洞穴或你挖出的空间中建造墙壁,以阻挡生物, 物体和液体的通过. 需要巨石, 块或木头.

text: You can place floors for functional reasons or to enhance the appearance of the fortress.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 你可以出于功能上的考虑或为了增强堡垒的外观而放置地板.  需要巨石, 木块或木材.

text: You can build a ramp next to a wall to provide access to the floor above.  The space above the ramp must also be empty.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 你可以在墙边建一个坡道,以提供通往上方楼层的通道.  坡道上方的空间也必须是空的.  需要巨石, 木块或木材.

text: You can build staircases to connect different elevations.  Staircases must span at least two elevations.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 你可以建造楼梯来连接不同的楼层.  楼梯必须至少横跨两层楼.  需要巨石, 木块或木材.

text: Fortifications block creature movement but allow projectiles through.  Soldiers near fortifications are reasonably safe from incoming projectiles.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 防御工事能阻挡住其他生物通过,但投掷物能越过它们. 在防御工事附近的战士们面对飞来的炮弹来说是相对安全的. 它需要石块, 石头或原木.

text: Use minecart tracks in conjunction with the hauling menu.
translation: 结合牵引菜单使用矿车轨道.

text: Place the well in an open space above water to provide a relatively safe area for your citizens to draw water.  Requires mechanisms, blocks, a chain or rope, and a bucket.
translation: 把井安置在水面的空地上,为你的公民提供一个相对安全的取水区域.  需要机械, 方块, 链条或绳子和水桶.

text: Use floodgates to control the flow of fluids between spaces in your fortress.  Must be attached to a lever or pressure plate to function.  Requires a floodgate object to be built before it can be placed.
translation: 使用水闸来控制你堡垒中各空间之间的液体流动.  必须连接到一个杠杆或压力板上才能发挥作用.  需要先建造一个水闸物体才能放置.

text: Use a screw pump to move liquids upward from the elevation below the pump to the same elevation as the pump.
translation: 使用螺杆泵将液体从泵下面的标高向上移动到与泵相同的标高.

text: Place the water wheel above flowing water to generate power for machines, such as the millstone or screw pump.
translation: 将水车置于流水之上,为机器发电,如磨石或螺旋泵.

text: Place the windmill aboveground to generate power for machines, such as the millstone or screw pump.  Not all areas have strong winds.
translation: 将风车放在地面上,为机器发电,如磨石或螺旋泵.  并非所有地区都有强风.

text: Use the gear assembly to connect axles and machinery together.  Gear assemblies can be disengaged temporarily by linking them to levers.
translation: 使用齿轮组件将轴和机械连接在一起.  齿轮组件可以通过与杠杆的连接而暂时脱离.

text: Horizontal axles transfer power on the same elevation.  Horizontal axles can be east-west or north-south.
translation: 水平轴在同一海拔高度上传递动力.  水平轴可以是东西或南北朝向的.

text: Vertical axles transfer power between two adjacent elevations.
translation: 垂直轴在两个相邻的立面之间传递动力.

text: They are so full of all those big words.
Who are these mealy-mouthed cowards trying to impress?
translation: 试图给人留下深刻印象的是这些懦弱的懦夫是谁?

text: There is a time for artful speech, and a time for blunt speech as well.
translation: 有时间进行巧妙的演讲,也有时间进行直言不讳.

text: Don't be afraid to do anything to get ahead in this world.
translation: 不要害怕做任何事情来在这个世界上取得成功.

text: Life isn't fair, and sometimes you have to do what you have to do, but working toward a balance isn't a bad thing.
translation: 生活是不公平的,有时你必须做你必须做的事情,但努力达到平衡并不是一件坏事.

text: What do you care how I speak or how I live?
translation: 你怎么在乎我说话或我的生活方式?

text: I can see a place for maintaining decorum, but it's exhausting to live that way.
translation: 我可以看到一个保持礼仪的地方,但这样的生活是令人筋疲力尽的.

text: It's admirable when the traditions are upheld.
translation: 当传统得到支持时,这是令人钦佩的.
有些事情永远不会改变.

text: We need to move beyond traditions.
We need to find a better way than those of before.
translation: 我们需要找到一种比以前更好的方法.

text: Some traditions are worth keeping, but we should consider their overall value.
translation: 有些传统值得保留,但我们应该考虑它们的整体价值.

text: Art is complicated.  I know what I like, but some I can do without.
translation: 艺术很复杂. 我知道我喜欢什么,但有些我无法做到.

text: It's better to work alone when possible, I think.  Cooperation breeds weakness.
translation: 我觉得,如果可以的话,最好单独工作. 合作会使得弱点萌生.

text: You should think carefully before embarking on a joint enterprise, though there is some value in working together.
translation: 在开始联合企业之前,你应该仔细考虑,尽管合作有一定的价值.

text: Nobody is free, and it is pointless to act as if you are.
translation: 没有人是自由的,像你一样行事毫无意义.

text: Personal freedom must be tempered by other considerations.
translation: 必须通过其他考虑来缓和个人自由.

text: One should not complain or betray any feeling.
translation: 一个人不应抱怨或背叛任何感觉.

text: Do not hide yourself behind an unfeeling mask.
translation: 不要把自己藏在一个无情的面具后面.

text: There are times when it is best to keep your feelings to yourself, but I wouldn't want to force it.
translation: 有时候最好保持对自己的感情,但我不想强迫它.

text: The quest for knowledge never ends.
translation: 对知识的追求永无止境.

text: All of that so-called knowledge doesn't mean a thing.
translation: 所有这些所谓的知识并不意味着什么.

text: Knowledge can be useful, but it can also be pointless or even dangerous.
translation: 知识可能很有用,但它也可能毫无意义甚至是危险的.

text: It is important to discover yourself.
Why would I waste time thinking about myself?
translation: 为什么我会浪费时间思考自己?

text: Some time spent in reflection is admirable, but you must not forget to live your life.
translation: 花在反思上的时间是令人钦佩的,但你不能忘记过你的生活.

text: I think self-control is key.  Master yourself.
translation: 我认为自我控制是关键. 掌握自己.

text: Why deny yourself your heart's desire?
translation: 为什么否认自己的心愿?

text: People should be able to control themselves, but it's fine to follow impulses that aren't too harmful.
translation: 人们应该能够控制自己,但是遵循不太有害的冲动也没关系.

text: The mind thinks best when the world is at rest.
Give me the bustle and noise over all that quiet!
translation: 给我一个安静的喧嚣和噪音!

text: I like a balance of tranquility and commotion myself.
translation: 我喜欢自己平静和骚动的平衡.

text: We should all be as one.  Why all the struggling?
translation: 我们都应该是一体的. 为什么所有人都在挣扎?

text: We grow through debate and struggle, even chaos and discord.
translation: 我们通过辩论和斗争,甚至是混乱和不和谐而成长.

text: Some discord is a healthy part of society, but we must also try to live together.
translation: 一些不和谐是社会的健康部分,但我们也必须共同生活.

text: It's great when we all get a chance to be merry together.
translation: 当我们都有机会一起欢乐时,这真是太好了.

text: Bah!  I hope you aren't celebrating something.
translation: 呸!?我希望你不是在庆祝.

text: I can take or leave merrymaking myself, but I don't begrudge people their enjoyment.
translation: 我可以自己接受或离开欢乐,但我不会嫉妒别人的享受.

text: An artisan, their materials and the tools to shape them!
translation: 工匠,他们的材料和塑造它们的工具!

text: A tool should get the job done, but one shouldn't obsess over the details.
translation: 一个工具应该完成工作,但不应该对细节有所顾忌.

text: A skilled warrior is a beautiful sight to behold.
translation: 熟练的战士是一个美丽的景象.

text: Why this obsession with weapons and battle?  I don't understand some people.
translation: 为什么这种对武器和战斗的痴迷?有些人我不懂.

text: The world isn't always safe.  I can see the value in martial training, the beauty even, but it shouldn't be exalted.
translation: 世界并不总是安全的. 我可以看到武术训练的价值,甚至美丽,但它不应该被提升.

text: The amount of practice that goes into mastering a skill is so impressive.
translation: 掌握技能的练习量令人印象深刻.

text: We should all be so lucky as to truly master a skill.
translation: 我们都应该如此幸运,才能真正掌握一项技能.

text: All of that practice is misspent effort.
translation: 所有这些练习都是错误的努力.

text: Everyone should broaden their horizons.  Any work beyond learning the basics is just a waste.

text: There's more to life than becoming great at just one thing, but being good at several isn't bad!
translation: 生活不仅仅是在一件事情上变得更好,而且擅长几个也不错!

text: I think people should hone their skills, but it's possible to take it too far and lose sight of the breadth of life.

text: The best way to get what you want out of life is to work for it.
translation: 获得生活中想要的东西的最好方法就是为它而努力.

text: Hard work is the true sign of character.
translation: 努力工作是品格的真正标志.

text: In life, you should work hard.  Then work harder.

text: Hard work is bested by luck, connections and wealth every time.
translation: 每次运气,关系和财富都会给人们带来艰苦的努力.

text: You shouldn't whittle your life away on working.
translation: 你不应该在工作上贬低你的生活.

text: It's foolish to work hard for anything.
Hard work is great.  Finding a way to work half as hard is even better.

text: I only work so hard, but sometimes you have to do what you have to do.

text: An earnest effort at any required tasks.  That's all that's needed.

text: We must be ready to sacrifice when the time comes.

text: Why harm yourself for anybody else's benefit?

text: Some self-sacrifice is worthy, but do not forget yourself in devotion to the well-being of others.

text: It's a competitive world, and you'd be a fool to think otherwise.

text: All of this striving against one another is so foolish.

text: There is value in a good rivalry, but such danger as well.

text: Anybody that sticks to something a moment longer than they have to is an idiot.

text: It's good to keep pushing forward, but sometimes you just have to know when it's time to stop.

text: It's best to slow down and just relax.

text: [B]The rhythm system is fundamentally polymetric.  There are always multiple rhythm lines, and the beats are always played together, even if one rhythm line completes (and then repeats) before the other is finished.  The rhythm lines are thought of as one, without a primary-subordinate relationship, though individual lines can be named.
translation: [B]这套节奏系统本质上是多节拍的。始终存在多条节奏线，各节拍总是同时演奏，即使某条节奏线先完成（然后重复）。这些节奏线被视为一体，没有主次之分，但各条节奏线可以有自己的名称。

text: [B]The rhythm system is fundamentally polyrhythmic.  There are always multiple rhythm lines, and each of their bars is played over the same period of time, regardless of the number of beats.  The rhythm lines are thought of as one, without a primary-subordinate relationship, though individual lines can be named.

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Farewell, [VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:NOBLE].  I look forward to our meeting next year.  Our fortunes rise and fall together.

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Greetings from the woodlands.  We have much to discuss.
translation: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：来自林地的问候。我们有许多事要商谈。

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Greetings, noble dwarf.  There is much to discuss.
translation: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：你好，尊贵的矮人。我们有许多事要商谈。

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  I am your liaison from the Mountainhomes.  Let's discuss your situation.
translation: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：我是来自山之家园的联络官。让我们来谈谈你们的情况。

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  It has been an honor, noble [VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:NOBLE].  I bid you farewell.
[C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  On behalf of the Merchants' Guild, let me extend greetings to your people.  There is much to discuss.
translation: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：我代表商会，向你们的民众致以问候。我们有许多事要商谈。

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  What a pleasant surprise!  Not a single tree here weeps from the abuses meted out with such ease by your people.  Joy!  The dwarves have turned a page, not that we would make paper.  A travesty!  Perhaps it is better said that the dwarves have turned over a new leaf, and the springtime for our two races has only just begun.
translation: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：真是令人惊喜！这里没有一棵树在哭泣，不必再轻易忍受你们族人的摧残。太棒了！矮人翻开了新的一页——不是说我们要造纸。那简直是暴殄天物！或许应该说，矮人改邪归正了，我们两族的春天才刚刚开始。

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  You have disrespected the trees in this area, but this is what we have come to expect from your stunted kind.  Further abuse cannot be tolerated.  Let this be a warning to you.
translation: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：你们亵渎了这片土地上的树木，不过这本就是我们预料之中你们这种矮小种族的行径。进一步的侵害绝不能容忍。就当这是对你们的警告。

text: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]: I don't know very much about the outside world.  I wish I had more to tell you.
translation: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：我对外面的世界了解不多。真希望能告诉你更多的事。
